title: HB2465 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-1): "National of the United States" shall have the same meaning as in title 8 United States Code section 1101.
SECTION 3 (HRS 134-2): The chief of police of the respective counties may issue permits to acquire firearms to citizens and nationals of the United States of the age of twenty-one years or more, or duly accredited official representatives of foreign nations, or duly commissioned law enforcement officers of the State who are aliens; provided that any law enforcement officer who is the owner of a firearm and who is an alien shall transfer ownership of the firearm within forty-eight hours after termination of employment from a law enforcement agency.
